_about: Gaps and problems found while pulling data.

gaps.text: Authorship, dating, audience, historical setting, cultural notes, map stops, the timeline, and chapter summaries come from no dataset. They're marked needs-review.
Range of meaning, English renderings, pronunciations, and notes are hand-written and need review. The STEPBible lexicon entry is shown alongside them.
Theographic's descriptions are Easton's Bible Dictionary (1897) and its dates are debated; neither is displayed.
The HelloAO Free Use Bible API and openbible.info aren't reachable from the build environment, so the WEB text and the cross-reference file come from GitHub mirrors (see the Sources page).
The Mediterranean Sea is pulled to draw the map.
Rome, the traditional place of Paul's imprisonment, isn't named in Colossians and lies off this map; Ephesus and Caesarea have also been suggested.
